::: {#perfil}

Deep learning researcher at GAIA Lab since 2023, working at the intersection of computer vision, artificial intelligence, and georeferenced data. Focuses on deep learning models for remote sensing applied to agribusiness, with emphasis on learning under noisy labels and uncertainty quantification. Master's student in Applied Mathematics and Data Science at FGV EMAp, and holds a bachelor's degree in Data Science and AI from the same school.

## Education

- MSc student in Applied Mathematics and Data Science, FGV EMAp.
- BSc in Data Science and AI, FGV EMAp.
- Technical degree in Informatics, IFSULDEMINAS.

## Interests

Artificial intelligence, remote sensing, and agribusiness.
